from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,importlib.util
from datetime import datetime
import requests,pdfplumber
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1'
assert not (OUT/'announcement_pdf_unit_clock_check.json').exists(),'公告单位/时钟核对已有记录。'
def save(name,d):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raw=json.loads((OUT/'fiscaldata_auction_query_raw.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['data'][0]
url='https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/static-data/published-reports/auctions-query/announcements/'+raw['pdf_filenm_announcemt']
save('announcement_pdf_unit_clock_registration.json',{'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'url':url,
 'same_fixed_first_api_record':True,'source_requests_max':1,'purpose':'核对同一公告XML与API的金额单位、原PDF公开时刻；不增加候选或查看收益。'})
response=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,20),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'});response.raise_for_status()
pdf=OUT/raw['pdf_filenm_announcemt'];pdf.write_bytes(response.content)
with pdfplumber.open(pdf) as doc:
 texts=[page.extract_text() or '' for page in doc.pages];count=len(doc.pages)
text='\n'.join(texts);pdf.with_suffix('.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
assert raw['cusip'] in text and '$70,000,000,000' in text and 'December 28, 2023' in text
assert 'Embargoed Until 11:00 A.M.' in text
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
published=pd_stamp=None
from datetime import datetime as DT
published=DT(2023,12,28,11,0,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York')).astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
xml=json.loads((OUT/'original_announcement_probe.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
values={v['tag']:v['text'] for v in xml['original_leaf_fields']}
assert float(values['OfferingAmount'])*1_000_000_000==float(raw['offering_amt'])==70_000_000_000
assert values['AnnouncementDate']==raw['announcemt_date']
assert values['AuctionDate']==raw['auction_date'] and values['IssueDate']==raw['issue_date']
rendered=[]
if importlib.util.find_spec('fitz'):
 import fitz
 with fitz.open(pdf) as doc:
  for i,page in enumerate(doc):
   dest=OUT/('公告原件_'+str(i+1)+'.png')
   page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(1.6,1.6),alpha=False).save(dest);rendered.append(dest.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
result={'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':'AMOUNT_AND_PRINTED_RELEASE_CLOCK_VERIFIED_FOR_ONE_BILL_ANNOUNCEMENT',
 'source_url':url,'pdf_path':pdf.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest(),
 'pages':count,'raw_api_offering_amt_dollars':70000000000,'xml_offering_amount_raw':values['OfferingAmount'],
 'xml_scale_in_this_sample':1000000000,'units_generalized_to_other_types':False,
 'printed_announcement_release_us_eastern':'2023-12-28T11:00:00-05:00',
 'printed_announcement_release_shanghai':published,'auction_date':raw['auction_date'],'issue_date':raw['issue_date'],
 'printed_release_time_is_contemporaneous_http_receipt':False,'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,
 'competitive_closing_time_is_publication_time':False,'original_pdf_amount_matches_api':True,
 'original_xml_dates_match_api':True,'source_security_type':'Bill','long_term_coupon_offers_checked':False,
 'rendered_pages':rendered,'visual_review':'PENDING','full_period_coverage_verified':False,'model_ready':False,
 'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'goal_achieved':False}
save('announcement_pdf_unit_clock_check.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('原文提取前700字符：'+text[:700])
